result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible layout issues caused by content being clipped or obscured at the viewport edges.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the second restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its associated details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar, or ensure the navigation does not cover content.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousels are visibly cut off at the right edge: a category pill and the third 'Fastest near you' restaurant card are only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has intentional partial-card spacing and a clear scroll affordance, or adjust the layout so clipped items do not look accidentally truncated.
